name: @wxyc/flowsheet-dj-name-scrub
description: One-shot dry-run-by-default scrub (BS#2281): recompute historical flowsheet.dj_name to the current PII-safe resolution chain via the canonical @wxyc/database helpers, and rewrite the marker message text that embeds a real name. Three id-cursor passes (main / message / orphan), idempotent by IS DISTINCT FROM the recomputed value (never IS NULL), cooperative live-DJ pause, ANALYZE-after, SIGTERM graceful stop. Reverses nothing: running legacy-dj-name-remediation or flowsheet-dj-name-backfill after this UNDOES it.
